from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-b7e40178.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    from collections import Counter\n    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):\n            if row[c] == bg and row[c - 1] != bg and row[c + 1] != bg and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1]:\n                out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
path.write_text(source)
# demo + test inputs
D=[[9]*7 for _ in range(27)]
for r,cs in {9:[1,3],10:[0,2],11:[0,2],20:[1,3],21:[1,3],23:[1,3,5],26:[0,2]}.items():
    for c in cs:D[r][c]=6
Y=[[9]*7 for _ in range(27)]
for r,cs in {9:[1,3],10:[0,2],11:[0,2],20:[1,3],21:[1,3],23:[1,3,5],26:[0,2]}.items():
    for c in cs:Y[r][c]=6
    for c in cs:
        if c+2 in cs:Y[r][c+1]=2
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print('demo matches',mod.transform(D)==Y)
test=[[7]*21 for _ in range(15)]
for r,cs in {1:[1,3,5],6:[2,4],8:[4,6,8,10,12]}.items():
    for c in cs:test[r][c]=4
result=mod.transform(test)
print(result)
